jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Dive into the world of construction permitting, licensing, & inspections. Success requires our team becoming experts and leading with curiosity, even if this is your first time designing for the pre-construction industry.

  • Identify and assess opportunities for UX and visual improvements in the PF application

  • Own strategy and decision-making for key product surfaces

  • Lead end-to-end design projects and work closely with our customers, engineering, and other teams to design internal and customer-facing applications

  • Set the bar for craft & ritual - establishing & strengthening our critique culture and overall design-centric approach

  • Collaborate with the sales and marketing team to produce sales collateral and branding material as needed

  • Help us design a really amazing permitting product that is not only beautiful, but works and scales

 

What We’re Looking For

  • All applications must link to or include a portfolio. We’re looking for your ability to craft design solutions in relevant or related product areas and an ability to deliver high-quality design thinking and product design in a fast-paced environment

  • 10+ years of experience designing dense B2B software; we're especially looking for experience with workflow-heavy products and complexity.

  • Our team primarily uses Figma, Notion, Linear. You should be comfortable with those or similar tooling.

  • High tolerance for ambiguity. We are moving fast, and our design, product, and engineering processes are constantly in flux. We value team members that can roll with this messiness and contribute to discussions on how to constantly improve.

  • Strong communication skills. Both designers and engineers and Permitflow spend significant time talking to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Technical competence. We're seeking "handoff" bar raisers who enjoy code – but we value design craft & the ability to effectively communicate designs and decisions with engineers over all.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

PermitFlow is looking for a Business Development Representative to support our core go-to-market motion across key customer verticals. This role is foundational to how we acquire new customers and scale revenue across Residential and Commercial Real Estate Development, Renewable Energy, and Home Services. You will be a front-line driver of pipeline, owning outbound engagement, building relationships with prospective customers, and converting interest into qualified sales conversations.

You will work closely with Account Executives and cross-functional partners to execute personalized outbound strategies, clearly communicate PermitFlow’s value in construction permitting, and generate new business through creative, multi-channel prospecting. This role requires comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment, strong ownership of outcomes, and a genuine interest in developing sales craft through repetition, feedback, and results.

This is not a passive or support-only SDR role. It is an opportunity to join a high-growth company, master outbound sales fundamentals, and play a meaningful role in shaping PermitFlow’s go-to-market execution, with a clear path for growth based on performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute high-volume outbound prospecting (80–100+ calls per day) across phone, email, and LinkedIn to engage prospective customers.

  • Leverage ABM campaigns to engage the right personas at the right time — using digital engagement signals, intent data, and local market insights.

  • Drive qualified meetings (SQLs) with decision-makers across the organization, including Permit Coordinators, Operations Leaders, Regional Directors, and Executive Leadership.

  • Personalize outreach using account research, industry context, regional insights, and relevant proof points.

  • Coordinate and cluster early wins — expanding from branch to branch, region to region, or franchise to franchise.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to document insights, share field intelligence, and refine our enterprise GTM motion.

  • Transition qualified opportunities to the Enterprise AE for pilot scoping or enterprise-level discussions.

  • Maintain clean CRM hygiene, consistent follow-up, and accurate forecasting within Salesforce.

What We’re Looking For

  • Curious Storyteller: You research deeply, craft tailored outreach, and can connect operational pain points to business value.

  • High-Volume Resilience: Comfortable making 80–100 calls per day and navigating rejection with consistency, energy, and professionalism.

  • Goal-Driven Mentality: Motivated by quotas, metrics, and continuous improvement; taking ownership of results.

  • Strong Communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to be clear, concise, and compelling.

  • Strategic Operator: Skilled at identifying buying centers and understanding complex org structures (enterprise orgs, roll-ups, franchises, multi-brand groups).

  • Team-Oriented: Thrive working side-by-side with AEs, Marketing, and RevOps to execute coordinated campaigns.

About the Role

As a Principal Product Designer at PermitFlow, you are the most senior individual contributor on the design team. You set the vision and the craft bar for our most complex, highest-leverage product surfaces, and you raise the ceiling for what design at PermitFlow can be. This is a hands-on role: you'll go deep on the hardest problems in construction permitting, and your influence felt in the quality of the product and in the impact of the designers around you.

Permitting is a workflow-dense, high-stakes, historically manual industry, and we are rebuilding that industry as an intelligent product. You will define how automation and AI show up in moonshots & strategic big-bet experiences. In our core product offerings, you'll ensure our users understand what the product is doing, trust its output, and stay in control of decisions that carry real financial and regulatory weight.

What You'll Do

  • Own the design vision for our highest-impact product areas, from framing the problem through pixel-perfect execution.

  • Set the strategic direction for how permitting workflows, automation, and AI-assisted decisions are designed, ensuring users can read, trust, and guide the product's output.

  • Partner with the Head of Design, product, and engineering leadership to shape the roadmap, not just execute against it, bringing a strong and well-reasoned point of view on where the product should go.

  • Raise the craft bar across the whole design team by modeling exceptional work, strengthening our critique culture, and mentoring designers without managing them.

  • Evolve the design language and systems thinking that let a small team ship cohesive, scalable experiences as our surface area grows.

  • Move fluidly between deep detail and big-picture direction while holding a high quality bar and a high pace of execution.

  • Become a functional expert on construction permitting, licensing, and inspections, leading with curiosity even if this is your first time in the pre-construction industry.

  • Collaborate with sales and marketing on collateral and branding as needed, and help us build a permitting product that is beautiful, that works, and that scales.

What We're Looking For

  • All applications must link to or include a portfolio. We want to see a track record of leading high-craft, complex products from concept through launch, with clear evidence of design decisions you drove and their impact.

  • 10+ years designing dense B2B software, with deep experience in workflow-heavy products and real complexity.

  • A demonstrated ability to operate as a force multiplier: elevating the work of other designers, defining what great looks like, and bringing structure to problem spaces that do not yet have any.

  • Strong systems thinking paired with exceptional interaction and visual craft. You sweat the details just as well as you guide strategy.

  • Experience designing AI-powered or highly technical products, or a clear point of view on how to make AI legible, trustworthy, and controllable for users.

  • High tolerance for ambiguity. We are moving fast, and our design, product, and engineering processes are constantly in flux. We want someone who thrives in that and helps improve it.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling. You can articulate design rationale and win alignment across designers, engineers, executives, and customers.

  • Technical fluency. We value designers who understand the realities of implementation and can partner deeply with engineers. Hands-on comfort with code is a plus.

  • Our team primarily uses Figma, Notion, and Linear. You should be comfortable with those or similar tooling, with comfort making tooling recommendations to leadership as new horizon models & solutions become available.

  • Own and evolve the systems that support Product planning, execution, launches, and measurement to ensure consistency, scalability, and clarity as the company grows.

  • Establish consistent quality standards and review processes across the Product organization, ensuring teams have clear goals, requirements, success metrics, and launch plans.

  • Partner closely with leadership to improve Product execution in ways that directly impact business metrics, including activation, retention, customer satisfaction, and product velocity.

  • Set the vision for how AI transforms the Product Operations function, driving adoption of AI tools and evolving workflows across the team.

 

What We’re Looking For

We’re open to calibrating the level of this role based on the candidate’s experience and scope of impact, from Manager through Head of Product Operations. We’re ultimately looking for the strongest product operations leader for the business, with title and scope matched to their track record and leadership experience.

  • Proven experience building Product Operations teams and functions from early-stage to scale.

  • Exceptional operational judgment across planning, prioritization, product development, launches, measurement, and cross-functional execution. Systems thinking, not just strong project management.

  • Player-coach mentality with the ability to do hands-on Product Operations work while simultaneously building and scaling a team.

  • Active AI fluency, with AI tools integrated into your daily operating workflow. Strong opinions on how AI is changing the way Product Operations teams work and a track record of evolving your own process accordingly.

  • Strong experience standing up Product operating processes, including planning rituals, PRD quality standards, launch readiness, product reviews, customer feedback systems, and product metrics.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership and hold your own in strategic and technical conversations.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

 

Closing

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build AI-powered products that simplify complex real-world workflows - and want to help define a category from the ground up - we’d love to talk.

 

Inside PermitFlow: The Team Transforming Construction Permitting

  • Travel as needed for customer meetings, industry conferences, and on-site program kickoffs

  • Strategic Seller: Skilled at navigating executive relationships, procurement, security reviews, and multi-division / multi-site rollouts

  • Problem-Solver & Storyteller: Capable of surfacing operational pain points and building compelling, ROI-backed business cases

  • Driving both new logo acquisition and portfolio expansion within existing accounts

  • Building repeatable, scalable processes that inform PermitFlow's commercial enterprise motion

  • Strength of executive relationships and ability to navigate complex, multi-site rollout strategies

About the Role

We're hiring a Director, Strategic Partnerships to take PermitFlow's partner ecosystem to the next level. We already have a meaningful set of partners across our core categories - the mandate for this seat is to go deeper with the ones we have and aggressively expand the ones we don't. You'll own the strategy, expansion, structuring, and revenue accountability across the full partner portfolio.

Permits don't happen in a vacuum. They sit inside a larger contractor stack - ServiceTitan, AccuLynx, JobNimbus, Salesforce, Procore, Buildertrend, CompanyCam - and they're funded, sold, and serviced through OEMs, distributors, financing partners, and trade associations. The contractor decision to standardize on PermitFlow is heavily influenced by who we integrate with, who recommends us, and who builds joint motions with us. Your job is to make PermitFlow the obvious permit layer of the home services and pre-construction ecosystem.

You'll report to the VP of Sales and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and the exec team. The role has clear pipeline and revenue accountability - partner-sourced and partner-influenced ARR are how we'll measure success.

What You'll Do

  • Define the partner strategy. Build the map: which categories matter (FSM/ISV, OEM/manufacturer, distributor, construction management, financing, trade association, AHJ/govtech, adjacent SaaS), where the leverage is, and which 5-10 partners we go deep with. Bring a point of view - don't wait for a playbook.

  • Recruit and sign foundational partners. Identify, pitch, negotiate, and close partnership agreements with target ISVs (e.g., ServiceTitan, AccuLynx, JobNimbus, Procore, Buildertrend), OEMs and distributors in HVAC / roofing / windows / doors / solar, financing partners, and trade associations.

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. Carry a number. Partnerships exist to drive deals - referrals, co-sells, embedded distribution. You'll own a target for partner-sourced ARR and partner-influenced pipeline, and you'll be measured against it.

  • Build the joint GTM motion. Partner with Marketing on co-branded campaigns, webinars, dealer/distributor events, and conference presence. Partner with Sales on co-sell motions, account mapping, and joint pursuits. Make the "better together" story real, not theoretical.

  • Own contract structuring and negotiation. Lead deal terms - referral economics, rev share, co-marketing commitments, integration scope, SLAs. Build the standard partnership agreement template with Legal so future deals close faster.

  • Be the product feedback loop from the ecosystem. Funnel integration requirements, API gaps, and partner-driven roadmap input back to Product. You're the voice of the ecosystem inside PermitFlow.

  • Stand up the partner program infrastructure. Build the partner tiering framework, onboarding playbook, enablement assets, scorecard, and QBR cadence. Make it scalable so we can hire underneath you in 12-18 months.

  • Represent PermitFlow externally. Speak at industry events (IRE, AHR Expo, GAF Roofing Academy, NAHB IBS, ServiceTitan Pantheon, etc.). Be the face of PermitFlow's partner motion to the ecosystem.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in Partnerships, Business Development, or Channel Sales - ideally at a B2B SaaS, vertical SaaS, ConTech, PropTech, or InsurTech company. You've signed real deals, run a partner number, and built joint motions that produced pipeline.

  • Track record of expanding and scaling, not just maintaining. You've taken existing partnerships from underperforming to producing real pipeline, and you've signed material net-new partners. You can talk through the mechanics of both motions - how you re-engineered a sleepy partner relationship and how you closed a cold one.

  • Quota / revenue accountability in your past. You've owned a partner-sourced pipeline number or rev share target - and you've hit or exceeded it. You can talk about your funnel, conversion math, and partner economics fluently.

  • Ecosystem fluency in home services / construction / contractor tech is a strong plus. Experience with FSMs (ServiceTitan, AccuLynx, JobNimbus, Workiz, FieldRoutes), construction management (Procore, Buildertrend), OEMs (GAF, Owens Corning, Carrier, Trane, Pella, Andersen), or financing platforms (GreenSky, Service Finance, Sunlight) is a major edge.

  • Exec-level presence. You've pitched VPs and C-suite at $500M+ companies and held your own. You're polished with execs, blunt with operators, and adapt to both.

  • Commercial sharpness. You structure deals that work. You know when to walk, when to push, and how to protect PermitFlow's economics. You don't sign vanity partnerships.

  • Builder mindset. You're going to write the partner playbook, the standard contract, the QBR template, and the partner scorecard. You see infrastructure as the unlock for scale.

  • High agency, low ego. You'll be in rooms with the CEO, CRO, Head of Product, and partner executives - often in the same week. You adapt, contribute, and don't wait for direction.

What Would Set You Apart

  • Built or scaled an integration partner program with the FSMs and CRMs our customers actually run on - ServiceTitan, AccuLynx, JobNimbus, FieldEdge, Workiz, Salesforce, Procore, or Buildertrend

  • Prior partnerships with HVAC, roofing, windows, doors, or solar OEMs (Carrier, Trane, GAF, Owens Corning, Pella, Andersen) or major distributors (ABC Supply, Beacon, SRS, Ferguson)

  • Active relationships inside the PE-backed home services rollup ecosystem - sponsors, operators, or advisors driving multi-jurisdiction trade consolidation (PermitFlow's largest deals live here)

  • Experience with AHJs / govtech platforms (Accela, Tyler, OpenGov), embedded contractor financing (GreenSky, Service Finance, Sunlight), or the trade associations our customers belong to (NRCA, NAHB, ACCA, ABC)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Flexible PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Hybrid NYC office culture (3 days in-office/week for NYC-based team) with direct access to leadership and exec team

  • In-office lunch & dinner provided

  • Travel to partners and customers - you'll see the ecosystem in the field, not just over Zoom

  • Translate operational outcomes — time-to-permit, throughput, cost, and risk reduction — into executive-grade ROI narratives

  • Own renewal and expansion forecasting, CRM hygiene, next steps, and close plans

  • Partner tightly with Implementation, Ops, and Customer Success on onboarding, operating cadence, health, adoption, and risk signals while holding a clean commercial swim-lane

  • Help build the Account Management playbook — handoffs, tiering, cadences, forecasting, account-planning standards

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Staff Analytics Engineer to build and shape the data foundation and intelligence layer powering PermitFlow's next stage of growth.

  • This is a high-impact, hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of analytics engineering, data analysis, and strategic decision-making. You'll own problems end-to-end: architecting our data warehouse, building reliable dbt models and pipelines, establishing trusted metrics, investigating complex business questions, and translating your findings into insights that drive meaningful business outcomes.

  • You'll work directly with leaders and teams across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer Success. Rather than operating as a centralized reporting function, you'll partner closely with the business to understand its most important challenges, identify opportunities hidden in the data, and build the analytical capabilities needed to act on them.

  • This role requires both deep technical expertise and strong business intuition. You'll spend substantial time building in SQL and dbt, while also getting hands-on with Python, exploring data, developing analytical models, and presenting recommendations that influence how the company operates and grows. We want someone who understands that great analytics engineering isn't just about building reliable data models; it's about making better decisions possible.

  • We're also building an AI-native data function. You'll have the opportunity to rethink traditional analytics workflows using LLMs and emerging technologies, from automating complex analysis to enabling teams across the company to access and act on data more independently.

You'll have the technical ownership to shape our data architecture, the business exposure to influence company-wide decisions, and the autonomy to build capabilities that will compound in value as PermitFlow scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own our data foundation: Architect, develop, and scale our data warehouse, dbt models, transformation pipelines, and core metrics. Establish reliable, well-structured data foundations that serve as the source of truth across the company. dbt will be a core part of your day-to-day work.

  • Drive analytics from question to impact: Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify high-value opportunities, investigate ambiguous business problems, conduct deep-dive analyses, and turn complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Build AI-powered analytics capabilities: Explore and implement LLM-powered workflows, AI agents, and automation to accelerate analysis, reduce manual work, improve data accessibility, and fundamentally rethink how teams interact with information.

  • Establish technical standards and data quality: Set the bar for data modeling, architecture, testing, documentation, observability, and governance. Build scalable systems that produce trusted, consistent, and reliable data as the business grows.

  • Influence strategic business decisions: Work directly with leaders across Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to define KPIs, evaluate business performance, identify operational bottlenecks, and uncover opportunities to improve efficiency, growth, and customer outcomes.

  • Make data accessible across the organization: Develop intuitive dashboards, reporting systems, and self-service analytics tools that empower teams to answer complex questions independently and make faster, better-informed decisions.

  • Shape our data strategy: Influence our long-term data architecture, tooling, technical roadmap, and operating model. Help define how a modern, AI-native data function should operate as PermitFlow scales.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep analytics engineering experience: Significant experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, data analytics, or business intelligence, with a track record of independently owning complex, high-impact initiatives.

  • Expert SQL and dbt skills: Exceptional SQL proficiency and deep, hands-on experience building production-grade dbt models, designing dimensional data models, and developing transformation workflows in modern cloud data warehouses.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: Proficiency in Python and experience building reliable, scalable data pipelines, analytical workflows, and data infrastructure.

  • AI-forward mindset: Practical experience leveraging LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered tools to improve analytics workflows, automate processes, or make data more accessible. You're curious about emerging technologies and excited to challenge traditional approaches.

  • Full-stack data capabilities: You combine strong engineering fundamentals with genuine analytical depth. You're equally comfortable architecting data models, writing production-quality code, exploring datasets, and developing insights that inform business decisions.

  • Exceptional analytical and business judgment: You know how to break down ambiguous problems, ask the right questions, identify meaningful patterns, and translate complex findings into clear recommendations with measurable business impact.

  • Technical leadership and ownership: You've independently led complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through execution. You can establish technical direction, influence architectural decisions, and raise the bar for engineering quality without relying on formal authority.

  • Strong communication and influence: You can partner effectively with engineers, executives, and business operators. You're able to explain technical trade-offs, communicate analytical findings, and influence decisions through clear, compelling reasoning.

  • A builder's mentality: You're proactive, resourceful, and energized by solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment. You take ownership beyond your immediate responsibilities and care deeply about the outcomes your work creates.

Why Join PermitFlow?

  • Build at an inflection point: Join a rapidly scaling, venture-backed company where you can shape foundational systems and influence the direction of the data function before it becomes entrenched.

  • Own problems that matter: Work on complex, high-impact challenges that directly influence how the company operates, scales, and serves its customers.

  • Define the future of AI-powered analytics: Help pioneer how LLMs and AI transform the way an organization accesses data, generates insights, and makes decisions.

  • Work directly with leadership: Partner closely with leaders across the company, giving you meaningful visibility into business strategy and the opportunity to influence decisions at every level.

  • Operate with autonomy and impact: Have the trust and ownership to take initiatives from initial idea to production, establish technical standards, and see your work translate into tangible business outcomes.

  • Shape something from the ground up: Help build the data capabilities, technical culture, and operating model that will support PermitFlow's next chapter of growth.

If you're excited about building the data foundation and intelligence layer behind an AI-native company, solving complex problems, and seeing your work directly shape how a business operates and grows, we'd love to meet you.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

About the Role

The Corporate Development function decides where PermitFlow should build, buy, and partner to accelerate growth. We look for deals that expand our product, open new routes to market, and move us deeper into the workflow of every construction project.

You'll own deals end-to-end and have the trust to shape where PermitFlow goes next.

  • Technical Judgment: Demonstrate strong technical judgment to critically evaluate target technologies and partner platforms, assess product-market fit, and align M&A or partnership strategies with long-term engineering roadmaps.

  • Own the Pipeline: Source, evaluate, and rank acquisition, strategic investment, and partnership opportunities across permitting, compliance, construction software, and adjacent workflows.

  • Drive Integration: Own post-close integration plans with the teams involved, and track whether each deal delivers on its thesis.

  • Review Partnership Results: Measure live partnerships against their original thesis and recommend where to double down or exit.

  • Build the Network: Build lasting relationships with founders, bankers, investors, and strategic partners so the best deals come to us first.

  • Bring Decisions to Leadership and the Board: Turn complex analysis into clear, short recommendations for the exec team and board.

  • 5+ years in investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate development, or M&A-focused strategy work at a high-growth company.

  • Deal operator: you have sourced, led diligence, negotiated, and closed M&A or strategic investments yourself.

  • Strong modeler: valuation, deal, and operating models are second nature.

  • Sharp judgment: you can learn a business fast and spot the two or three factors that matter most.

  • Clear prioritizer: you can weigh competing opportunities against company goals and make a firm call on what to pursue.

  • Commercial negotiator: comfortable across the table from founders, executives, and sophisticated counterparties.

  • Structured communicator: distills complexity into simple, actionable recommendations.

  • Builder mindset: comfortable with limited process, a lot of ambiguity, and full ownership from idea to integration.

  • Bonus: experience in construction, vertical SaaS, or regulated markets.

  • Excited to build at a hyper-scale startup redefining how America builds.

  • Hybrid in NYC: in office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

  • Design the monorepo for agents. Structure packages, ownership, the build graph, and conventions so an agent can find the right context, make a scoped change, and verify it without reading the whole repo.

  • Build the platform substrate. Own the shared services, infrastructure, and paved paths (data access, background jobs, environments, observability) that product teams build on and agents can use safely.

  • Own the agentic SDLC. Define how work moves from ticket to production when agents do much of the writing, testing, and reviewing. Set the defaults every team builds on, and change them as models and tools improve.

  • Scale verification with volume. Build AI-assisted code review, test generation, and CI gates so confidence to merge keeps pace as PR volume doubles. Decide where human review is required and where it is not.

  • Put agents to work in the background. Stand up agents that pick up well-scoped tickets, triage flaky tests, run dependency upgrades and large migrations, and draft fixes from incidents and error reports.

  • Strong platform and infrastructure depth: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, and services you've run in production through real incidents.

  • You can work across the stack as a product engineer, from data model to UI, and you're happy to do it.

  • You work agent-first today. A large share of the code you ship comes from AI coding agents, and you have specific, earned opinions on where they break and how codebase structure fixes that.

  • Current knowledge of the agentic stack as it applies to software engineering: context engineering, agent instructions and skills, MCP, sandboxed execution, and how to evaluate a coding agent's output.

  • You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate.

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including time setting technical direction across multiple teams.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

Role Overview

We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer to build PermitFlow's core product AI Assistant, infrastructure, and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel.

Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow.

The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build.

This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the agent architecture. Design the reasoning loop, planning and decomposition strategy, state and session model, and recovery behavior for long-running tasks.

  • Build the context layer. Retrieval, memory, and context-window management over project documents, jurisdictional requirements, prior submissions, and customer-specific conventions.

  • Design the action surface. Define the tools the assistant can call, the permissions model around them, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints for actions that are expensive or irreversible.

  • Make evaluation the engine of progress. Stand up offline and online eval harnesses that measure task completion and failure modes. Build the iteration loop that lets the whole team improve agent quality on evidence.

  • Set the bar for the org. Establish the abstractions, SDKs, and review standards other engineers build agentic features on.

  • Stay close to the customer. Sit with permit coordinators and builders, watch the assistant fail in real conditions, and bring that back into the system design.

 

What We're Looking For

  • You've shipped an assistant or agentic product at meaningful scale

  • Deep, current knowledge of the agentic stack (tool calling and tool design, context engineering, memory, retrieval, orchestration patterns, etc)

  • You’ve built eval harnesses that changed what a team worked on, and you can articulate what makes an eval trustworthy.

  • You are a genuinely strong software engineer, not an AI specialist who needs someone else to make it production-ready. You’ve owned services in production and you write code that other people are glad to inherit.

  • You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate.

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with recent time spent building LLM-powered products.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
